items.title: Texas State University and adidas Partner with Athletic Solutions to Launch adidas NIL Locker Rooms for All Bobcat Student-Athletes
items.summary: SAN MARCOS, Texas – Texas State University and adidas are proud to announce a groundbreaking partnership with Athletic Solutions, marking a new era of empowerment for student-athletes through the launch of official adidas NIL Locker Rooms for every student-athlete who opts-in.

items.title: United Rentals Announced as Official Rental Solution of Texas State Athletics
items.summary: SAN MARCOS, Texas – Texas State Athletics has announced a significant three-year sponsorship agreement with United Rentals, North America's largest equipment rental company, as the "Official Rental Solution of Texas State Athletics." The Bobcats debuted the new partnership in front of a national television audience at Boise State on October 31 with highly visible coaches headsets as a keystone asset.

items.title: Bradley Earns Pac-12 Conference Defensive Player of the Week Honors
items.summary: SAN MARCOS, Texas – Texas State defensive back Jayden Bradley has been named the Pac-12 Defensive Player of the Week following his performance in the Bobcats' 42-21 road victory over Oregon State on Saturday night.

items.title: Game Recap: Bobcats Dominate Oregon State on the Road, 42-21
items.summary: CORVALLIS, Ore. (AP) — Torrance Burgess Jr. ran for 196 yards and a touchdown, Davian Jackson ran for three scores and surpassed 100 yards rushing, and Texas State rolled past Oregon State 42-21 on Saturday night.

items.title: Game Recap: Bobcats Take No. 20 Boise State to the Wire but Fall, 46-45
items.summary: BOISE, Idaho (AP) -- Max Cutforth threw three touchdown passes in the final seven minutes in relief of injured starter Maddux Madsen, and No. 20 Boise State rallied to beat Texas State 46-45 on Saturday night after blowing a 25-point halftime lead.

items.title: Jenkins Named Pac-12 Special Teams Player of the Week
items.summary: SAN MARCOS, Texas – Texas State football's Jaylen Jenkins was named Pac-12 Special Teams Player of the Week after returning a kickoff 100 yards for a touchdown in the Bobcats' 20-17 win over Utah State.
